description: This file defines a class Psr17FactoryProvider within the Slim Framework, responsible for managing a list of PSR-17 factory class names. It provides methods to retrieve, set, and add factories to this list.

classes.name: Psr17FactoryProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing a list of PSR-17 factory class names used within the Slim Framework.

methods.name: getFactories
methods.description: Returns the current array of factory class names.

methods.name: setFactories
methods.description: Replaces the current array of factory class names with the provided array.

methods.name: addFactory
methods.description: Adds a new factory class name to the beginning of the factories array.
